props.name: size
props.description: Width and height in pixels. The blob is square.

props.name: wobble
props.description: How far the outline wanders from a circle, 0 to 1.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one full cycle of the slowest wave.

props.name: points
props.description: Control points. More gives a busier outline; 6 to 10 reads best.

props.name: fill
props.description: Fill. A gradient is what stops it looking like a puddle.

props.name: reactive
props.description: Follow the pointer — the blob bulges towards it.
